people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
translations.bsb: Peter replied, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the other disciples said the same thing.
translations.kjv: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
translations.asv: Peter saith unto him, Even if I must die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
